subject: Request: Temporary sprint credits while purchase order undergoes validation
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@luminahealth.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@luminahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot purchase order in validation — timeline update

Hi David and Camila,

Quick update from our side: the PO for the pilot (Lumina Health / Redwood, 3-month sandbox) is with our AP team for validation. They flagged a vendor verification step that the vendor onboarding team needs to complete — our finance lead expects that to finish this week but there is a chance it slips into next week.

We want to keep the sandbox active for our ML team while finance finishes the checks. Would Redwood be open to a short-term credit or token top-up to cover the next ~10 days so we don't lose momentum? If helpful I can attach the PO draft and the vendor details.

Thanks — appreciate any flexibility.

Best,
Alex
Alex Morgan
Head of ML Infrastructure
Lumina Health

Attachment: Lumina_PO_draft.pdf
From: david_kim@redwood.com <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@luminahealth.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot purchase order in validation — timeline update

Alex — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO draft.

We can absolutely help bridge this. Proposed quick option: we provision a temporary sprint credit (non-billable voucher) that will keep your sandbox live for a 7–10 day window while procurement completes vendor verification. To do that I need: 1) a PO number or PO draft (PDF is fine), and 2) an expected approval date from your AP team. We can also do staged provisioning (5k tokens to start, top-up if approval slips).

If that works, I’ll get Camila to queue the voucher and coordinate with Engineering to ensure the sandbox doesn't auto-shutdown. Note: these credits are one-time and intended to preserve demo/test data during the procurement handoff.

Can you confirm the expected clearance date, and attach the PO number when available?

—David
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot purchase order in validation — timeline update

Thanks, David — appreciate it.

PO update: our AP team assigned PO# LH-2027-1105 and vendor verification moved faster than expected; they now target formal sign-off on Monday, 28 Jun. That said, there's still a non-zero chance of an extra day if additional docs are requested.

Would you be able to do a 10-day buffer to be safe? Our ML lead asks that the environment remain reachable for a short spike of model runs next Tuesday. I've attached the PO draft and an invoices summary so you can see expected line items.

Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot purchase order in validation — timeline update

Alex — thanks for the PO number and the timeline. We’ll approve a 10-day temporary credit to preserve the sandbox while your AP finalizes sign-off.

What I’m provisioning: 10 calendar days of sandbox credits (non-billable), equivalent to a 5,000-token starter top-up plus automatic 2,500-token contingency on day 6 only if approval still hasn’t arrived. This should cover burst runs next Tuesday. Credit will be tied to DEAL-5721 / PO LH-2027-1105 and will be revoked automatically after the buffer window if we don’t receive an executed PO.

Camila — can you queue the credit and confirm the voucher ID once created? Rachel, please add a note to the HubSpot deal record (link below) and set a reminder for 2027-07-08 to check whether the executed PO landed.

Alex — once the PO is fully executed we'll apply it retroactively and reconcile any usage against the order. If your team needs additional runway beyond the 10 days, loop me in and we can discuss options (staged purchase, accelerated invoicing, or a short sponsorship).

—David
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0192
